verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-first SDK across TypeScript, Python, and Go, so its core capabilities are all exposed programmatically rather than through a UI. These include act/extract/observe, raw page methods, browser launch and CDP attach, persistent contexts, caching and self-heal. They are also exposed as agent tools (run/snapshot/screenshot) over MCP. The only UI in evidence is the Browserbase session dashboard with recording and replay, and nothing shows those dashboard features are also reachable through the API; the OpenAPI probe found no published REST spec. Missing for 10: evidence of API access to dashboard/observability features (session replay), a published machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration of UI–API parity.
